definitions.full: H4204. mazor II. מָזוֺר noun masculine Obadiah 7 ׳יָשִׂימוּמ תַּחְתֶּיךָ , very dubious, perhaps net (as something extended ): ᵐ5 ( ἔνεδρα ), ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ambush (? מָצוֺד or מְצוֺדָה net , Vollers ZAW 1884, 16 ; מָצוֺר siege Prince JBL xvi.1897, 177 ), Aq Theod fetter, bond , ᵑ7 ( תקלא ) stumbling-block ; Gr מִכְמָר מַכְמֹר, ; We Now leave untranslated; Dl Prol. 67, HWB 396 compare Assyrian mazûru , apparently a pole with an iron hook , but improbable — 1. מָזוֺר see below II. זוּר , p. 267. מִזְרֶה see זרה .
definitions.rootNote: from 2114 in the sense of turning aside from truth;

occurrences.englishText: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”
